t_advice_summary_textbox.text: different coloured gnomes produce different amounts of mushrooms. This can change during the game. For example at the start of the game a pink gnome may pick the highest number of mushrooms, but in time, this number may lessen.

vb_textbox.text: The most important thing to remember is not to be too slow. If you are too slow you will forfeit any mushrooms/points. It appears that certain coloured gnomes produce more mushrooms than others, so try and remember which colour gnome finds the largest number of mushrooms. After a while of that coloured gnome producing the largest number, this will shift to the opposite coloured gnome in that gnome pair.
